summary: Copies a small data pair from source a2 into the this object: one byte from a2+0 into this+0x19, and the word at a2+2 into this+0x1A. Returns the copied word. No branches, no calls. Existing analysis (DERIVED) reads the pair as a collision body type field + handle/index word used during collision body initialization.

operations.description: Copy source byte into body type field: *(BYTE*)(this+25) = *(BYTE*)a2.
Read the source word at a2+2 and store it into the handle field: *(WORD*)(this+26) = *(WORD*)(a2+2).
Return the copied word from the handle field (this+0x1A).
Called by TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder (0x004493A0) and CollisionCapsuleShapeCopyToPipeline (0x0044B040) to initialize collision-body fields.

unresolved: Semantics of the copied byte+word pair are only DERIVED from prose (collision body type + handle); the owning collision-body class is unknown.
Whether the returned word is consumed by the callers is not established.
